# Presentations

## Problem Gambling

```{=html}
<div style="position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; max-width: 100%; margin-bottom: 24px;">
  <iframe 
    src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/e/2PACX-1vSwpVmbPGBdov6-HGBiCKl0VVbis1wY1gmWkrxmlF0V55SQYyICAmugQBy2YFGEapHrArG4-Iajcgh8/pubembed?start=false&loop=false&delayms=30000"
```

**Description:** I have a passion for data visualization and an interest in [problem gambling](https://www.ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/faqs-what-is-problem-gambling/) as an under-discussed public health concern. Above is a presentation I created as a part of an independent project to share some concerning problem gambling trends. These figures were made using the Matplotlib library in Python.

## Water Quality

```{=html}
<div style="position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; max-width: 100%; margin-bottom: 24px;">
  <iframe 
    src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/e/2PACX-1vRCxI6hXJ1BQPXRtymlfWwiY_ibM_zEcjDaCi31eC9RM2Lpb9wiABKnVVZEV67qVQok2dYsVMTr1r3t/pubembed?start=false&loop=false&delayms=30000"
    style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" 
    allowfullscreen>
  </iframe>
</div>
```

**Description:** As a part of a 2025 internship with the [Chesterfield County Department of Environmental Engineering](https://www.chesterfield.gov/272/Environmental-Engineering), I created a presentation highlighting a few key trends related to their catalogue of unanalyzed water quality data. At the end of the internship, I presented these trends to department staff. These figures were made using the Matplotlib library in Python.
